title: You Only Live Twice: Financial Inflows and Growth in a Westward-Facing Ukraine
title_zh: 《你只活两次：面向西方的乌克兰的资本流入与增长》
title_primary: 《你只活两次：面向西方的乌克兰的资本流入与增长》
title_secondary: You Only Live Twice: Financial Inflows and Growth in a Westward-Facing Ukraine
authors: Yuriy Gorodnichenko, Maurice Obstfeld
official: 官方在线 2026-01-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The monumental task of rebuilding postwar Ukraine requires early planning and identification of growth strategies.The earlier accession of Eastern European countries to the European Union and NATO offers a template that relies on massive foreign direct investment and public structural funds.This approach helps to raise incomes directly and can create a virtuous circle where capital deepening facilitates technological upgrades and repatriation of war refugees, which in turn stimulate more investment.We show theoretically that the government can refine this strategy by internalizing positive externalities from having a higher capital stock: Investment in physical capital relaxes borrowing constraints (thus allowing more capital inflows) and raises wages (thus encouraging more Ukrainian refugees to return home).
abstract_zh: 重建战后乌克兰的艰巨任务需要早期规划并明确增长战略。东欧国家早前加入欧盟和北约提供了一个模板，该模板依赖于大规模的外国直接投资和公共结构基金。这种方法有助于直接提高收入，并能形成一种良性循环，其中资本深化促进技术升级和战争难民遣返，进而激发更多投资。我们从理论上表明，政府可以通过内化更高资本存量带来的正外部性来优化这一战略：实物资本投资放宽了借贷约束（从而允许更多资本流入）并提高了工资（从而鼓励更多乌克兰难民回国）。

title: Why Financial Literacy Is Essential for Fixing a Broken Personal Finance System: A Review of Fixed: Why Personal Finance Is Broken and How to Make It Work for Everyone by John Y. Campbell and Tarun Ramadorai
title_zh: 金融素养为何对修复失灵的个人金融体系至关重要：《固定：个人金融为何失灵及如何使其惠及所有人》述评
title_primary: 金融素养为何对修复失灵的个人金融体系至关重要：《固定：个人金融为何失灵及如何使其惠及所有人》述评
title_secondary: Why Financial Literacy Is Essential for Fixing a Broken Personal Finance System: A Review of Fixed: Why Personal Finance Is Broken and How to Make It Work for Everyone by John Y. Campbell and Tarun Ramadorai
authors: Lusardi, Annamaria
official: 来源期次 Journal of Economic Literature · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This review assesses John Campbell and Tarun Ramadorai’s book entitled Fixed. Why Personal Finance is Broken and How to Make It Work for Everyone. The volume is an excellent discussion of the research on household finances around the world. Most importantly, the authors examine how and why the financial system tends to fail instead of helping consumers and retail investors. Campbell and Ramadorai also propose solutions to the problem, including stronger regulation and simplified financial instruments. However, if the system is to work for most of us, an additional factor is required: better financial literacy. Indeed, enhancing financial knowledge is essential if people are to be empowered to make better financial decisions, guard against deceptive practices, utilize financial instruments to their benefit, and take advantage of the opportunities offered by financial markets and the government. Without such basic knowledge, regulation and simplified financial instruments will not fix personal finance.
abstract_zh: 本综述评价了约翰·坎贝尔与塔伦·拉马多拉伊合著的《固定收益：为何个人理财失灵及如何使其惠及所有人》一书。该书对全球家庭金融研究进行了精彩论述。最重要的是，作者探讨了金融体系为何及如何倾向于失灵，而非帮助消费者和散户投资者。坎贝尔与拉马多拉伊还提出了解决方案，包括加强监管和简化金融工具。然而，若要使该体系惠及大多数人，还需一个额外因素：更好的金融素养。确实，提升金融知识对于赋予人们做出更优财务决策、防范欺诈行为、利用金融工具获益以及把握金融市场和政府提供的机会至关重要。缺乏这种基础知识，监管和简化金融工具将无法修复个人理财问题。

title: Measures of Macroeconomic Shocks and Uncertainty for Asia-Pacific Economies
title_zh: 亚太经济体宏观经济冲击与不确定性度量
title_primary: 亚太经济体宏观经济冲击与不确定性度量
title_secondary: Measures of Macroeconomic Shocks and Uncertainty for Asia-Pacific Economies
authors: Iris Claus & Leo Krippner
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop standardized time-series measures of shocks and uncertainty for output growth and inflation across 14 Asia-Pacific economies using data from Consensus Economics survey of professional economic forecasters. They are based on changes in mean forecasts and standard deviations, adjusted for intra-year patterns that arise from the annual-average percent changes basis of the data. As an example of how our shock measures may be used, we apply the vector autoregression method of sign restrictions to decompose output growth and inflation shocks into fundamental demand and supply shocks. Those shocks and our uncertainty measures align well with major economic events such as the Asian Financial Crisis, the COVID-19 pandemic, and geopolitical conflicts. We show that our uncertainty measures most closely reflect the concept of macroeconomic uncertainty, with apparent differences to established economic policy uncertainty measures across all comparable economies, but a close relationship with two well-known macroeconomic uncertainty measures produced only for the United States. Hence, extending the measures of macroeconomic uncertainty to all 14 economies in our analysis, along with the shocks for those economies, creates a valuable dataset for economic policy setting and empirical research.
abstract_zh: 我们利用Consensus Economics对专业经济预测者的调查数据，为14个亚太经济体构建了产出增长和通胀的标准化时间序列冲击与不确定性度量。这些度量基于平均预测值及标准差的变化，并根据数据以年度平均百分比变化为基础所产生的年内模式进行了调整。作为冲击度量应用的一个示例，我们采用符号约束的向量自回归方法，将产出增长和通胀冲击分解为基本的需求与供给冲击。这些冲击及我们的不确定性度量与亚洲金融危机、新冠疫情及地缘政治冲突等重大经济事件高度吻合。我们表明，我们的不确定性度量最贴近宏观经济不确定性的概念，在所有可比经济体中与既定的经济政策不确定性度量存在明显差异，但与仅为美国生成的两个知名宏观经济不确定性度量关系紧密。因此，将宏观经济不确定性度量扩展至我们分析中的全部14个经济体，并连同这些经济体的冲击度量，为经济政策制定和实证研究创造了宝贵的数据集。

title: From care-takers to breadwinners? Gendered livelihoods’ dynamics under climate change: Implications for resilient livelihood planning
title_zh: 从照料者到养家者？气候变化下的性别化生计动态：对韧性生计规划的影响
title_primary: 从照料者到养家者？气候变化下的性别化生计动态：对韧性生计规划的影响
title_secondary: From care-takers to breadwinners? Gendered livelihoods’ dynamics under climate change: Implications for resilient livelihood planning
authors: Francis Dakyaga, Fuseini Waah Salifu, Samuel Z. Bonye, Emmauel K. Derbile
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Gender and climate change scholars have demonstrated how gendered livelihood (re)produces unequal vulnerabilities between men and women shaped by differentiated adaptive capacities. In response,human-nature interaction scholars underscore the reciprocal relationship between human beings and the environment by highlighting their mutual agency and the ability of environmental change to shape the formation and transformation of gendered livelihoods.Inspired by the human-nature interaction studies,we explore how communities’ responses, coping and adapting to climate change, shape the formation and transformation of gendered livelihood strategies. Drawing on the gendered lens, we explored the everyday lived experiences of rural communities under climate change; analysed gendered livelihood formation (resource access, control and power relations); examined gendered livelihood transformation under climate change; and offered reflections on the implications for resilient livelihood planning. The study found that gendered livelihood practices are transforming as communities’ respond to climate change. Women were found engaged in farming, out-migration, livestock and poultry rearing, complementary but contradictory to livelihood strategies perceived as feminine.The constellation of livelihood activities and strategies practised by women enhanced their resilience capacities to climate change but increased their domestic and economic burdens through simultaneous engagement in productive and reproductive roles. Men were perceived as more vulnerable in adapting their livelihoods to climate change. We argue that policy planning interventions toward rural livelihood enhancement should focus on improving the productive adaptive capacities of both men and women towards fostering resilient livelihoods.
abstract_zh: 性别与气候变化学者已经证明，性别化的生计方式如何（再）生产出男女之间因适应能力差异而形成的不平等脆弱性。对此，人与自然互动研究者通过强调人与环境的相互能动性以及环境变化塑造性别化生计形成与转型的能力，着重指出了人与环境之间的互惠关系。受人与自然互动研究的启发，我们探讨了社区对气候变化的响应、应对及适应过程如何塑造性别化生计策略的形成与转型。借助性别视角，我们考察了气候变化下农村社区的日常实际生活经验；分析了性别化生计的形成（资源获取、控制与权力关系）；审视了气候变化下性别化生计的转型；并就其对韧性生计规划的意义提出了反思。研究发现，随着社区对气候变化的响应，性别化生计实践正在发生转型。女性从事农耕、外出迁移、畜禽养殖等活动，这些活动与被视为女性化的生计策略既互补又矛盾。女性所实践的多样化生计活动与策略组合增强了她们应对气候变化的韧性能力，但同时也通过同时承担生产性与再生产性角色，加重了她们的家务与经济负担。男性在使其生计适应气候变化方面被认为更为脆弱。我们认为，旨在提升农村生计的政策规划干预应着重于提高男性和女性的生产性适应能力，以促进韧性生计的培育。

title: Anchored in Troubled Waters: Monetary Unions and Uncertainty
title_zh: 锚定于动荡水域：货币联盟与不确定性
title_primary: 锚定于动荡水域：货币联盟与不确定性
title_secondary: Anchored in Troubled Waters: Monetary Unions and Uncertainty
authors: Benjamin Born, Luis Huxel, Gernot Müller, Johannes Pfeifer
official: 官方在线 2020-12-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: A monetary union shapes the impact of uncertainty on the economy: it does not alter the transmission of common uncertainty shocks, but significantly dampens the adverse effects of country-specific shocks. We establish this result based on time series data for 17 euro-area countries and 13 countries with flexible exchange rates. To rationalize it, we propose a model of a monetary union in which monetary policy responds to common shocks but not to country-specific ones, as each member country is small. The union dampens the effect of country-specific shocks by providing a nominal anchor in the face of country-specific uncertainty, thereby eliminating price level risk.

title: Going separate ways: spatial sorting by education, work, and real income in the USA since 1970
title_zh: 分道扬镳：1970年以来美国教育、工作与真实收入的空间分选
title_primary: 分道扬镳：1970年以来美国教育、工作与真实收入的空间分选
title_secondary: Going separate ways: spatial sorting by education, work, and real income in the USA since 1970
authors: Frigon, Anthony, Storper, Michael
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Advanced economies have undergone enormous structural change in work, income distribution, and the skills of the working population over the past half century. These changes have driven changing geographies of people and households, which are sorted across regions according to their work and incomes. A key previous finding is that high-skill workers have been increasingly concentrating in large metropolitan areas, earning significant wage premiums, while returns to low-skill, lower-wage work shows less spatial variation and tends to be tied to local demand for nontradable services. However, this bipartite division loses considerable information. In this paper, we therefore use a tripartite division (high-, medium-, and low-skilled) to shed additional light on the changing spatial reality of population sorting. Our research generates robust evidence that medium-skill workers have been increasingly spatially separated away from high-skill workers. The middle-skilled and the high-skilled are much less exposed to one another than was the case in the past, a reality that is lost when using only two groups. In addition, we show how spatial sorting of the three groups has affected their relative economic welfare, by documenting shifting real incomes for the three groups in the places where they are dominant. This reflects systematic differences in how their housing costs and their wages evolve relative to each other, an effect of occupational wage differences, on one hand, and spatial sorting on the other. Even though sorting of the middle group in the direction of smaller noncoastal areas does reduce the gap in real incomes relative to the gap when such workers remain in high-skilled
abstract_zh: 过去半个世纪，发达经济体的工作结构、收入分配以及劳动人口的技能水平经历了巨大的结构性变化。这些变化推动了人口与家庭地理格局的演变，人们根据其工作和收入在不同地区间进行分选。先前的一项关键发现是，高技能工人日益集中于大都市区域，并获得显著的工资溢价，而低技能、低工资工作的回报则表现出较小的空间差异，且往往与当地对非贸易服务的需求紧密相关。然而，这种二分法划分丢失了大量信息。因此，本文采用三分法划分（高、中、低技能），以进一步揭示人口分选的空间现实变化。我们的研究提供了稳健的证据，表明中等技能工人日益在空间上与高技能工人分离。中等技能与高技能群体之间的相互接触程度远低于过去，而这一现实在使用仅两组划分时被掩盖了。此外，我们通过记录三组群体在其主导地区的实际收入变化，展示了这三组群体的空间分选如何影响其相对经济福利。这反映了他们的住房成本与工资相对于彼此演变的系统性差异，这一效应一方面源于职业工资差异，另一方面源于空间分选。尽管中等技能群体向较小非沿海地区的分选确实缩小了其实际收入差距，相较于这些工人若留在高技能主导地区时的差距而言，情况有所改善。

title: Welfare effects of passive partial ownership in differentiated Bertrand duopoly with optimal technology licensing

title_primary: 差异化伯特兰双寡头中被动部分持股的福利效应及最优技术许可

authors: Aditya Chowdhury, Priyodorshi Banerjee
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study a technologically asymmetric, differentiated Bertrand duopoly where the technologically superior firm is a passive partial owner of its rival, and technology transfer occurs through optimal two-part licensing. We show that technology is always transferred in equilibrium, and that passive partial ownership uniformly reduces consumer surplus but can enhance social welfare when product differentiation is low and technological asymmetry is high. The analysis highlights a key trade-off between competitive intensity and efficiency gains from technology diffusion, offering new insights into the welfare and antitrust implications of partial ownership arrangements.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个技术不对称、产品差异化的伯特兰双寡头市场，其中技术领先企业被动部分持有其竞争对手的股份，且技术转移通过最优两部许可实现。研究表明，均衡状态下技术总会发生转移，而被动部分持股始终降低消费者剩余，但在产品差异化程度低且技术不对称程度高时，可能提升社会福利。分析凸显了竞争强度与技术扩散带来的效率提升之间的关键权衡，为部分持股安排的社会福利及反垄断影响提供了新见解。

title: Nurturing the future: How positive parenting is related to children’s skills and well-being
title_zh: 培育未来：积极教养如何影响儿童技能与福祉
title_primary: 培育未来：积极教养如何影响儿童技能与福祉
title_secondary: Nurturing the future: How positive parenting is related to children’s skills and well-being
authors: Laura Breitkopf, Shyamal Chowdhury, Shambhavi Priyam, Hannah Schildberg-Hörisch, Matthias Sutter
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the relationship between maternal parenting style and a broad range of children’s skills and outcomes. Using survey and incentivized experimental data from 5644 children aged 6 to 16 and their parents, we find that children whose mothers are classified as practicing a positive parenting style score higher on IQ, are more altruistic, exhibit higher openness, conscientiousness, and agreeableness, and have a higher locus of control, self-control, and self-esteem. They also perform better in scholarly achievement tests, display more prosocial behavior in everyday life, and report higher life satisfaction. Additionally, positive parenting is negatively associated with children’s patience, neuroticism, engagement in risky behaviors, and their emotional and behavioral problems.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了母亲教养方式与儿童广泛技能及成果之间的关系。利用来自5644名6至16岁儿童及其父母的调查和激励性实验数据，我们发现，被归类为采用积极教养方式的母亲所养育的儿童，在智商测试中得分更高，更加利他，展现出更高的开放性、责任心和宜人性，并且拥有更强的内部控制点、自我控制和自尊。他们在学业成就测试中表现更佳，在日常生活中展现出更多亲社会行为，并报告更高的生活满意度。此外，积极教养与儿童的耐心、神经质、参与风险行为及其情绪和行为问题呈负相关。

title: Disentangling Probabilistic and Strategic Errors
title_zh: 区分概率性错误与策略性错误
title_primary: 区分概率性错误与策略性错误
title_secondary: Disentangling Probabilistic and Strategic Errors
authors: Geng, Sen, Guan, Menglong
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: In many strategic environments with asymmetric information, systematic decision mistakes can arise from two sources: failures in probabilistic reasoning when updating beliefs and incorrect strategic inference about opponents’ private information or choices. Using a sequential belief elicitation design in persuasion games, we experimentally disentangle and quantify these two reasoning errors. We find that probabilistic and strategic reasoning errors are comparable in magnitude, largely orthogonal, and their patterns and overall degree are stable across various settings. These results suggest that an improved behavioral theory should account for both strategic naivete and non-Bayesian updating, without significant concern for their interaction.
abstract_zh: 在许多存在信息不对称的战略环境中，系统性决策失误可能源于两个因素：更新信念时的概率推理失误，以及对对手私人信息或选择的错误战略推断。通过在说服博弈中采用序贯信念诱导设计，我们通过实验分离并量化了这两种推理错误。研究发现，概率推理错误与战略推理错误在量级上相当，且基本相互独立，其模式与总体程度在不同情境下保持稳定。这些结果表明，改进的行为理论应同时考虑战略天真与非贝叶斯更新，而无需过度关注二者的交互作用。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Conditional cash transfers (CCTs) have been found to have several benefits, particularly with respect to educational outcomes of targeted children. However, concerns have also been raised that CCTs may further push women into traditional gender norms, as they make mothers responsible for ensuring that their children meet the conditionalities and that their family receives the transfer. We analyze 2020–21 time use data from Colombia, and find that the CCT Familias en Acción increased the time that mothers allocated to domestic work, particularly when they have children aged 6–14. This pattern does not come from a substitution between children’s and mothers’ domestic labor, but, rather, reveals that the cash transfer enabled women to decrease their labor force participation during the pandemic – but that their time was then reallocated toward more domestic work, following traditional norms.
abstract_zh: 有条件现金转移（CCTs）已被发现具有多项益处，尤其是在改善目标儿童的教育成果方面。然而，也有人担忧，CCTs可能进一步将女性推向传统性别规范，因为它们要求母亲负责确保子女满足条件要求，并确保家庭获得转移支付。我们分析了哥伦比亚2020-21年的时间使用数据，发现CCT项目“家庭行动”增加了母亲分配给家务劳动的时间，尤其是在她们有6-14岁子女的情况下。这一模式并非源于儿童与母亲家务劳动之间的替代，而是揭示了现金转移使女性在疫情期间能够减少劳动力参与——但她们的时间随后被重新分配至更多家务劳动，遵循了传统规范。

title: Women’s labor subsidy: Evidence from Chile
title_zh: 女性劳动补贴：来自智利的证据
title_primary: 女性劳动补贴：来自智利的证据
title_secondary: Women’s labor subsidy: Evidence from Chile
authors: Maria Isidora Palma, Valentina Paredes, Daniela Paz
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In this paper, we study the effects of the Women’s Labor Subsidy (WLS), introduced in 2012, on women’s labor outcomes. We use detailed administrative records for more than 2.5 million women that allow us to analyze employment and income trajectories before, during, and after the implementation of the subsidy. Using a regression discontinuity design that exploits the fact that eligibility is contingent upon falling below a specified vulnerability score cutoff, we analyze how eligibility and being a program beneficiary affect labor outcomes. Our results indicate no significant effects of WLS eligibility on women’s employment, months worked, or income. We also find null effects on labor outcomes for program beneficiaries. The null effect is relatively consistent across different subgroups of eligible women.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2012年实施的女性劳动补贴（WLS）对女性劳动结果的影响。我们利用超过250万女性的详细行政记录，分析了补贴实施前、实施期间及实施后的就业与收入轨迹。通过采用断点回归设计，利用资格取决于是否低于特定脆弱性评分阈值的特征，我们分析了资格认定及成为项目受益人对劳动结果的影响。研究结果表明，WLS资格对女性就业、工作月数或收入均无显著影响。同时，项目受益人的劳动结果也未发现显著效应。这一零效应在不同合格女性子群体中相对一致。

title: Risk linkages between international energy prices and the Chinese stock market: insights from TVP-VAR and wavelet analysis
title_zh: 国际能源价格与中国股市的风险关联：基于TVP-VAR与小波分析的洞见
title_primary: 国际能源价格与中国股市的风险关联：基于TVP-VAR与小波分析的洞见

authors: Yangsong Liu, Qingsha Hu, Ruofei Wu, Chaofan An
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study employs a TVP-VAR method and wavelet analysis to investigate the risk linkages and volatility spillovers between energy and stock markets. The key findings are as follows. First, significant risk spillovers exist between the international energy market and the Chinese stock market, with volatility predominantly driven by long-term components. Moreover, these dynamic spillovers tend to intensify during extreme events. Second, energy price fluctuations serve as a leading indicator for stock market risk dynamics. Third, frequency heterogeneity exists between energy and stock markets. From a policy perspective, regulatory authorities should improve the macro-regulatory system – by building strategic energy reserves and advancing early warning systems – to bolster financial stability.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用TVP-VAR方法与小波分析，探讨能源市场与股票市场之间的风险关联及波动溢出效应。主要发现如下：第一，国际能源市场与中国股票市场之间存在显著的风险溢出，波动主要由长期成分驱动。此外，此类动态溢出在极端事件期间趋于加剧。第二，能源价格波动可作为股票市场风险动态的先行指标。第三，能源市场与股票市场之间存在频率异质性。从政策视角看，监管机构应完善宏观调节体系——通过构建战略能源储备与推进预警系统建设——以增强金融稳定性。

title: The Pass-Through of Retail Crime
title_zh: 零售犯罪的传导效应
title_primary: 零售犯罪的传导效应
title_secondary: The Pass-Through of Retail Crime
authors: Hase, Carl, Kasinger, Johannes
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper shows that retailers increase prices in response to organized retail crime. We match store-level crime data to scanner data from the universe of transactions for cannabis retailers in Washington state. Using quasi-experimental variation from robberies and burglaries, we find a 1.7-1.8% price increase at victimized stores and nearby competitors. This rise is not driven by short-to-medium-term demand changes but is consistent with crime-related cost shocks. Effects are larger for independent stores and less concentrated markets. We estimate that crime imposes a 1% ‘hidden’ unit tax on affected stores, implying $30.7 million additional social costs, primarily borne by consumers.
abstract_zh: 本文表明，零售商在应对有组织零售犯罪时会提高价格。我们将门店层面的犯罪数据与华盛顿州大麻零售商的全量交易扫描数据相匹配。利用抢劫和入室盗窃带来的准实验性变化，我们发现受害门店及其附近竞争对手的价格上涨了1.7%-1.8%。这一价格上涨并非由短期至中期的需求变化驱动，而是与犯罪相关的成本冲击相一致。独立门店及市场集中度较低的区域受影响更大。我们估算，犯罪对受影响门店施加了1%的“隐性”单位税，这意味着额外社会成本达3070万美元，主要由消费者承担。

title: Delaying the Inevitable? U.S. Screwworm Closures and Feeder Cattle Market Dynamics
title_zh: 推迟不可避免之事？美国螺旋蝇检疫封锁与架子牛市场动态
title_primary: 推迟不可避免之事？美国螺旋蝇检疫封锁与架子牛市场动态
title_secondary: Delaying the Inevitable? U.S. Screwworm Closures and Feeder Cattle Market Dynamics
authors: Shelby Sumner, Savannah Jones, Tania Islam, K. Aleks Schaefer
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Biosecurity trade restrictions are commonly framed as preventive measures, yet in many settings they function primarily as policies of delay: they impose immediate market costs while only postponing the arrival of biological risks. This paper evaluates that intertemporal tradeoff using the 2024–2025 US suspension of live cattle imports from Mexico in response to the northward spread of New World Screwworm (NWS). We estimate a vector autoregression (VAR) using monthly data from 2004 to 2025 to characterize pre‐ban dynamics in feeder cattle prices, Mexican import volumes, fed cattle prices, and feed costs, and construct counterfactual forecasts for prices and trade flows absent the border closures. Translating these costs into a simple break‐even framework shows that under an annual endemic‐loss assumption of $10 billion, each additional month of border closure would need to delay endemic NWS establishment by approximately 4 months to be welfare improving.
abstract_zh: 摘要 生物安全贸易限制通常被视为预防性措施，但在许多情境下，它们主要发挥延迟政策的作用：这些限制在施加即时市场成本的同时，仅能推迟生物风险的到来。本文利用2024-2025年美国因新世界螺旋蝇（NWS）向北蔓延而暂停从墨西哥进口活牛的案例，评估了这一跨期权衡。我们基于2004年至2025年的月度数据，估计了一个向量自回归（VAR）模型，以刻画禁运前架子牛价格、墨西哥进口量、育肥牛价格及饲料成本之间的动态关系，并构建了无边境关闭情形下价格与贸易流的反事实预测。将这些成本转化为简单的盈亏平衡框架后显示，在每年10亿美元的地方性损失假设下，边境关闭每延长一个月，需将NWS地方性建立推迟约4个月，才能实现福利改善。

title: Competition and Misconduct in Certification Markets with Externalities
title_zh: 外部性下认证市场的竞争与不当行为

authors: Nano Barahona, Juan-Pablo Montero, Pedro Skorin
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Vehicle inspections—commonly known as smog and safety checks—are often delegated to private agents, much like other quality certification markets. When these agents compete, they face incentives to misreport quality—especially when consumers do not internalize the external costs of misreporting. Theory and evidence from Chile’s concentrated vehicle-inspection markets suggest that these incentives are significant: misreporting emerges as soon as competition is introduced. We find that delegating each market to a single agent proves effective in reducing approval rates, without compromising service quality or the ex-ante competition for the market, while delivering substantial and permanent reductions in vehicle emissions.
abstract_zh: 车辆检测——通常称为尾气与安全检查——常被委托给私人代理机构，这与许多质量认证市场类似。当这些代理机构相互竞争时，它们面临虚报质量的动机——尤其是在消费者未将虚报的外部成本内部化的情况下。来自智利集中型车辆检测市场的理论与证据表明，这些动机十分显著：一旦引入竞争，虚报行为便随之出现。研究发现，将每个市场委托给单一代理机构能有效降低通过率，且不会损害服务质量或市场的事前竞争，同时实现车辆排放的显著且持久减少。

authors: Yutong Chen, Kerem Coşar, Devaki Ghose, Shirish Mahendru, Sheetal Sekhri
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Reducing gender-specific commuting barriers in developing countries can have heterogeneous effects on women’s labor outcomes. We study a program that offers free bus rides for women in several Indian states (the Pink Slip program) using a synthetic difference-in-differences approach to examine impacts on transportation expenditures, time use, and labor supply. We find that the program substantially reduces bus-related expenditures. However, when considering all women together, we find no significant changes in travel time, household production, or labor supply. Beneath these aggregate effects, responses vary sharply by employment, marital status, and education. Unmarried women employed prior to the policy increase labor supply, while married women with low and medium levels of education reallocate time away from paid work toward household chores. Overall employment rates remain unchanged in the short run, highlighting that reducing commuting costs does not uniformly improve women’s labor market outcomes.
abstract_zh: 在发展中国家，减少针对性别差异的通勤障碍可能对女性的劳动结果产生异质性影响。我们利用合成双重差分法，研究印度多个邦实施的女性免费公交乘车计划（“粉红票”计划），分析其对交通支出、时间利用和劳动供给的影响。研究发现，该计划显著降低了与公交相关的支出。然而，从全体女性来看，通勤时间、家务生产或劳动供给并未发生显著变化。在这些总体效应之下，不同群体的反应因就业状况、婚姻状况和教育水平而存在显著差异。政策实施前已有工作的未婚女性增加了劳动供给，而中低教育水平的已婚女性则将时间从有偿工作转向家务劳动。总体就业率在短期内保持不变，这表明降低通勤成本并不能一致地改善女性的劳动力市场结果。

title: Quantifying the impact of a personal income tax reform on tax revenues, growth and inequality in Hungary
title_zh: 量化匈牙利个人所得税改革对税收收入、经济增长与不平等的影响
title_primary: 量化匈牙利个人所得税改革对税收收入、经济增长与不平等的影响

authors: Michaël Sicsic
official: 官方在线 2026-06-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper analyses the impact of introducing progressivity into the Hungarian personal income tax (PIT) system on tax revenues, growth and inequality. This reform would strengthen labour market participation by reducing the labour tax wedge for low-income earners and improve the responsiveness of tax revenues to economic growth. Using a framework combining static effects and behavioural responses along both the extensive margin (employment effects) and the intensive margin (substitution and income effects), and accounting for tax buoyancy, the analysis shows that the reform becomes revenue-enhancing once these dynamic effects are considered. Aligning capital income taxation more closely with labour taxation further strengthens tax revenues. The comprehensive reform would raise the tax-to-GDP ratio by 0.4–0.8pp by 2040, depending on the specific reform scenario and assumed parameters. By stimulating employment among low- and middle-income workers and despite moderate disincentives for higher-income earners, the reform would boost potential GDP in all scenarios. The reform would also significantly reduce income inequality and strengthen redistribution.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了在匈牙利个人所得税体系中引入累进性对税收收入、经济增长及不平等的影响。这一改革将通过降低低收入者的劳动税楔来增强劳动力市场参与度，并提高税收收入对经济增长的响应能力。通过采用结合静态效应与行为反应（涵盖广延边际的就业效应和集约边际的替代效应与收入效应）的分析框架，并考虑税收弹性，研究表明一旦纳入这些动态效应，该改革将提升税收收入。将资本收入税与劳动税进一步协调，可进一步强化税收收入。根据具体改革方案和假设参数，到2040年，全面改革将使税收占GDP比重提高0.4至0.8个百分点。通过刺激中低收入者的就业（尽管对高收入者产生适度抑制效应），该改革在所有情景下均能提升潜在GDP。此外，改革还将显著降低收入不平等并强化再分配效应。

official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates recruitment bias in the academic job market. We examine the link between statistical significance and placement outcomes for 200 empirical job market papers from 2018-2021. Marginally significant results are associated with higher academic placement likelihoods , suggesting a preference for statistical significance. This bias may incentivize questionable research practices. The COVID-19 pandemic intensified these dynamics, with marginal significance gaining greater weight in hiring decisions during competitive periods. Evidence of publication bias indicates recruiters may use statistical significance to predict future publications, shaping hiring decisions. These findings highlight systemic challenges to research integrity in economics.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了学术就业市场中的招聘偏见。我们分析了2018至2021年间200篇实证求职论文，考察统计显著性与就业结果之间的关联。边缘显著的结果与更高的学术职位获得可能性相关，表明存在对统计显著性的偏好。这种偏见可能助长可疑的研究实践。COVID-19疫情加剧了这一动态，在竞争激烈时期，边缘显著性在招聘决策中权重增加。出版偏见的证据表明，招聘者可能利用统计显著性预测未来发表情况，从而影响招聘决策。这些发现凸显了经济学研究诚信面临的系统性挑战。

authors: Lena Gerling, Arzu Kibris
official: 官方在线 2026-04-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines how exposure to armed conflict affects group-specific trust, focusing on individuals exposed during military service. Our identification strategy exploits a population-level natural experiment generated by Turkey’s strict military conscription system and its long-running civil conflict. We combine this setting with an original field survey to identify causal effects and examine individual-level mechanisms while minimizing contextual confounding. We find that men exposed to the armed conflict during their conscription service exhibit elevated ingroup trust, with no corresponding increase in trust toward outgroups or in generalized trust. In contrast, those with battlefield traumas display lower trust overall. Exposed veterans also display stronger ingroup-biased attitudes like nationalism, intolerance, religiosity, and adherence to social norms. These results suggest that conflict exposure shifts social preferences toward ingroup favouritism without strengthening broader forms of trust, a pattern that is likely to hinder the accumulation of social capital and, in turn, adversely affect long-run economic development and institutional quality. abstract_zh: 本研究探讨武装冲突经历如何影响群体特定信任，重点关注服役期间暴露于冲突的个体。我们的识别策略利用土耳其严格兵役制度及其长期内战冲突所产生的人口层面自然实验。通过结合这一情境与原创实地调查，我们在最小化情境混杂因素的同时识别因果效应并考察个体层面机制。研究发现，在服役期间暴露于武装冲突的男性表现出更强的内群体信任，但对外群体信任或普遍信任并未相应提升。相反，经历战场创伤的个体整体信任水平较低。暴露于冲突的退伍军人还表现出更强的内群体偏好倾向，如民族主义、不宽容、宗教虔诚及对社会规范的遵从。这些结果表明，冲突经历将社会偏好转向内群体偏袒，却未能强化更广泛的信任形式，这种模式可能阻碍社会资本积累，进而对长期经济发展和制度质量产生不利影响。

title: Unequal and Unstable: Income Inequality and Bank Risk
title_zh: 不平等与不稳定：收入不平等与银行风险
title_primary: 不平等与不稳定：收入不平等与银行风险
title_secondary: Unequal and Unstable: Income Inequality and Bank Risk
authors: YULIYAN MITKOV, ULRICH SCHÜWER
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-04-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We present a model in which income inequality interacts with banks' risk‐taking incentives, generating financial instability. Competition and deposit insurance cause some banks to lend to lower‐income borrowers at underpriced rates, creating “risky banks” that fail in downturns, while others lend to higher‐income borrowers and avoid default. Rising inequality affects stability by expanding the underpriced loan segment and increasing the share of risky banks. Moreover, borrower risk does not automatically imply bank risk: without risk‐shifting, no bank fails, even as borrowers become riskier. The model identifies when inequality heightens bank risk and clarifies the mechanisms connecting inequality, lending behavior, and financial fragility.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个模型，其中收入不平等与银行的风险承担激励相互作用，从而引发金融不稳定。竞争和存款保险导致部分银行以低于合理定价的利率向低收入借款人放贷，形成在经济下行时倒闭的“风险银行”，而其他银行则向高收入借款人放贷并避免违约。收入不平等的加剧通过扩大低价贷款部分并增加风险银行的占比来影响稳定性。此外，借款人风险并不自动意味着银行风险：在没有风险转移的情况下，即使借款人风险增加，也没有银行会倒闭。该模型识别了不平等何时加剧银行风险，并阐明了连接不平等、放贷行为与金融脆弱性的机制。

title_secondary: We Value Your Privacy: Behavior‐Based Pricing Under Endogenous Privacy
authors: Friederike Heiny, Tianchi Li, Michel Tolksdorf
official: 官方在线 2025-12-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study a duopoly model of behavior-based pricing in which consumers can either disclose or hide their data. We contrast two data policies. Under an open data policy, disclosed data is shared with all firms. In the unique equilibrium, all consumers disclose, and firms price discriminate, leading to welfare losses from inefficient poaching. Under an exclusive data policy, disclosed data is accessible only to the firm from which a consumer previously purchased. In the unique equilibrium, all consumers hide, prices are uniform, and the market is efficient. We test these contrasting predictions in an experiment. Under the open data treatment, subjects predominantly act as predicted but do not fully disclose. Under the exclusive data treatment, buyers initially excessively disclose as sellers reward loyalty, but shift toward hiding as sellers begin employing poaching strategies. The discrepancy between theoretical and observed privacy choices can be explained by the presence of consumers who, irrespective of the data policy, are committed to either disclosing or hiding their data.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个基于行为定价的双寡头模型，其中消费者可以选择披露或隐藏其数据。我们对比了两种数据政策。在开放数据政策下，披露的数据对所有企业共享。在唯一均衡中，所有消费者都选择披露，企业实施价格歧视，导致因低效挖角而产生的福利损失。在独家数据政策下，披露的数据仅对消费者之前购买过的企业可见。在唯一均衡中，所有消费者都选择隐藏，价格统一，市场效率高。我们通过实验检验了这些对比鲜明的预测。在开放数据处理下，受试者主要按预测行事，但并未完全披露。在独家数据处理下，买家最初因卖家奖励忠诚而过度披露，但随着卖家开始采用挖角策略，他们转向隐藏。理论与观察到的隐私选择之间的差异，可以通过存在一些消费者来解释，这些消费者无论数据政策如何，都坚定地选择披露或隐藏其数据。

title: Bankruptcy Law and the Market for Corporate Influence
title_zh: 破产法与公司影响力市场
title_primary: 破产法与公司影响力市场
title_secondary: Bankruptcy Law and the Market for Corporate Influence
authors: Mike Burkart, Samuel Lee, Vladimir Vladimirov, Gita Gopinath, Josefin Meyer 等
official: 官方在线 2025-10-25 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The canonical view of bankruptcy law is that it solves a market failure by imposing a collective choice process that supplants the market. We propose that bankruptcy law instead catalyzes the market if that process provides scope for rent seeking. Considering collective action problems as the central friction, as in the canonical theory, we argue that such a law induces activist investing that improves the efficiency of distressed restructuring. This expands the purview of bankruptcy law from a focus on bargaining issues to an active role in regulating corporate control contestability. We interpret the evolution of Chapter 11 and the surrounding market environment through this lens.
abstract_zh: 破产法的经典观点认为，它通过施加一种取代市场的集体选择过程来解决市场失灵问题。我们提出，如果该过程为寻租提供了空间，破产法反而会催化市场。与经典理论一致，将集体行动问题视为核心摩擦，我们认为此类法律会激发积极投资，从而提升困境重组的效率。这将破产法的范畴从聚焦谈判问题扩展至在规范公司控制权可竞争性方面发挥积极作用。我们通过这一视角解读第11章及其周边市场环境的演变。

title: Loan Evergreening through Banks' Lenses: Evidence from Credit Product‐Level Data
title_zh: 银行视角下的贷款常青化：来自信贷产品层面数据的证据
title_primary: 银行视角下的贷款常青化：来自信贷产品层面数据的证据
title_secondary: Loan Evergreening through Banks' Lenses: Evidence from Credit Product‐Level Data
authors: CECILIA DASSATTI, RODRIGO LLUBERAS, FRANCESC RODRIGUEZ‐TOUS
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2025-10-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the different rationales behind zombie lending. Exploiting granular data of different corporate loan types, we identify loan evergreening as instances where firms receive interest‐only loans to repay existing amortizing loans. Avoidance of losses that erode bank capital is an important reason for zombie lending to multiple‐bank firms, but not to single‐bank firms. When banks provide loan evergreening to single‐bank firms, these firms are less likely to receive credit and additional loan evergreening by the bank in the future, more likely to default, and to start new lending relationships afterward; this is consistent with banks providing loan evergreening to allow less creditworthy borrowers to obtain additional financing elsewhere and reduce their own exposure. Finally, zombie lending to multiple‐bank firms leads to credit displacement, but zombie lending to single‐bank firms does not.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了僵尸贷款背后的不同动机。利用不同企业贷款类型的细粒度数据，我们将贷款常青化识别为企业通过获得仅付息贷款来偿还现有分期偿还贷款的情形。避免侵蚀银行资本的损失，是银行对多银行企业进行僵尸贷款的重要原因，但对单一银行企业则不然。当银行向单一银行企业提供贷款常青化时，这些企业未来获得该银行信贷及额外贷款常青化的可能性较低，更可能违约，并随后建立新的贷款关系；这与银行提供贷款常青化以使信用较差的借款人能在别处获得额外融资并减少自身风险敞口的解释相符。最后，对多银行企业的僵尸贷款导致信贷挤出，而对单一银行企业的僵尸贷款则无此效应。
